preregistration.title: Seeded application maintenance corpus
preregistration.description: Cross-language comparison of agents modifying four existing hidden-correct programs to satisfy new application requirements.

matrix.derivation: 6 complete four-task maintenance bundles x 3 languages

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-task success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check task success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict maintenance-corpus parity.

interpretation_boundary: The primary result is the within-iteration Parley/Python/Rust comparison under gpt-5.6-sol.
The four requirement extensions and their public/hidden cases are new, but the seed programs are preserved hidden-correct outputs from iteration 023.
This related-source design measures maintenance work and cannot count as independent language-feature recurrence.
Every agent receives the exact starting source in its measured prompt and workspace; final and seed source sizes plus deterministic rough-token edit counts are recorded.
Cross-iteration movement is descriptive only because the unit of work changed from cold-start generation to seeded maintenance.
secondary_analysis: Report every session, task outcome, repair, token count, elapsed time, prompt size, seed/final source size, edit size, integrity result, and command-protocol result.
Classify every first-check and hidden failure by maintenance family and independent session.
Compare Parley seed, final, and edit size with Python and Rust to test whether compact source materially helps maintenance.
Report repair-free sensitivity if at least two Parley sessions pass all four tasks on the first check.
preregistration.feature_boundary: Parley remains frozen at v0.3.155 with the exact 1,519-character skill. Only the language-neutral benchmark harness gained optional seed-source presentation and edit-size measurement; cold-start behavior remains backward compatible.
preregistration.change_rule: No syntax, compiler, grammar, AST, checker, runtime, diagnostic, prompt skill, or benchmark instruction may change from iteration 024 output. This related-source corpus cannot satisfy independent recurrence. Future proposals require unrelated new tasks and independent sessions, then general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability review.
preregistration.instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character skill remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is injected once per Parley session. The one allowed instruction-compression experiment is closed.
preregistration.stop_rule: Preserve the complete result without selective reruns. If strict parity passes, preregister a broader real-repository confirmation before claiming general parity. If it fails, make no same-corpus language or instruction change; choose the next evidence source by external validity rather than transcript syntax.

source_texts.notes_index_extension:
to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let notes be an empty list of text
    let nonempty be 0
    let characters be 0
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let note be ask ""
        add note to notes
        if length of note is more than 0:
            set nonempty to nonempty + 1
        set characters to characters + (length of note)
    write title + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    write "" to file "file_backed_notes_index.txt"
    let note_index be 1
    repeat count times:
        let note be item note_index of notes
        append note + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
        if length of note is more than 0:
            append note_index + "|" + note + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes_index.txt"
        set note_index to note_index + 1
    let saved be read file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    say title + "|" + count + "|" + nonempty + "|" + characters
source_texts.invoice_net_extension:
to main:
    let customer be ask ""
    let item_input be ask for a number ""
    let item_count be value of item_input
    let totals be a map from text to number
    let subtotal be 0
    repeat item_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let category be item 1 of parts
        let quantity be item 2 of parts as number
        let price be item 3 of parts as number
        let amount be quantity * price
        set subtotal to subtotal + amount
        if totals contains category:
            set item category of totals to item category of totals + amount
        otherwise:
            set item category of totals to amount
    let output be an empty list of text
    let categories be keys of totals
    for each category in categories:
        add category + ":" + item category of totals to output
    let discount be 0
    if subtotal is at least 2000:
        set discount to floor of (subtotal divided by 10)
    let net be subtotal - discount
    say customer + "|" + subtotal + "|" + (output joined with ",") + "|discount=" + discount + "|net=" + net
source_texts.shipment_cancellation_extension:
to main:
    let shipment_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let shipment_count be value of shipment_count_input
    let states be a map from text to text
    repeat shipment_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        set item (item 1 of parts) of states to item 2 of parts
    let event_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let event_count be value of event_count_input
    let invalid be 0
    repeat event_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let shipment_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains shipment_id:
            let state be item shipment_id of states
            if state is "created" and action is "pack":
                set item shipment_id of states to "packed"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "ship":
                set item shipment_id of states to "shipped"
            otherwise if state is "shipped" and action is "deliver":
                set item shipment_id of states to "delivered"
            otherwise if state is "created" and action is "cancel":
                set item shipment_id of states to "cancelled"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "cancel":
                set item shipment_id of states to "cancelled"
            otherwise:
                set invalid to invalid + 1
        otherwise:
            set invalid to invalid + 1
    let results be an empty list of text
    let shipment_ids be keys of states
    for each shipment_id in shipment_ids:
        add shipment_id + ":" + item shipment_id of states to results
    say (results joined with ",") + "|invalid=" + (invalid as text)
source_texts.wildcard_policy_extension:
to main:
    let policy_roles be an empty list of text
    let policy_resources be an empty list of text
    let policy_actions be an empty list of text
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        add item 1 of parts to policy_roles
        add item 2 of parts to policy_resources
        add item 3 of parts to policy_actions
    let request_input be ask for a number ""
    let request_count be value of request_input
    let allowed be 0
    let denied be 0
    repeat request_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let user be item 1 of parts
        let role be item 2 of parts
        let resource be item 3 of parts
        let action be item 4 of parts
        let matched be no
        let policy_index be 1
        repeat count times:
            let policy_role be item policy_index of policy_roles
            let policy_resource be item policy_index of policy_resources
            let policy_action be item policy_index of policy_actions
            if (policy_role is "*" or policy_role is role) and (policy_resource is "*" or policy_resource is resource) and (policy_action is "*" or policy_action is action):
                set matched to yes
            set policy_index to policy_index + 1
        if matched:
            say user + ":allow"
            set allowed to allowed + 1
        otherwise:
            say user + ":deny"
            set denied to denied + 1
    say "allowed=" + allowed + ",denied=" + denied

sources.shipment_cancellation_extension:
to main:
    let shipment_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let shipment_count be value of shipment_count_input
    let states be a map from text to text
    repeat shipment_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        set item (item 1 of parts) of states to item 2 of parts
    let event_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let event_count be value of event_count_input
    let invalid be 0
    repeat event_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let shipment_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains shipment_id:
            let state be item shipment_id of states
            if state is "created" and action is "pack":
                set item shipment_id of states to "packed"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "ship":
                set item shipment_id of states to "shipped"
            otherwise if state is "shipped" and action is "deliver":
                set item shipment_id of states to "delivered"
            otherwise if state is "created" and action is "cancel":
                set item shipment_id of states to "cancelled"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "cancel":
                set item shipment_id of states to "cancelled"
            otherwise:
                set invalid to invalid + 1
        otherwise:
            set invalid to invalid + 1
    let results be an empty list of text
    let shipment_ids be keys of states
    for each shipment_id in shipment_ids:
        add shipment_id + ":" + item shipment_id of states to results
    say (results joined with ",") + "|invalid=" + (invalid as text)
sources.wildcard_policy_extension:
to main:
    let policy_roles be an empty list of text
    let policy_resources be an empty list of text
    let policy_actions be an empty list of text
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        add item 1 of parts to policy_roles
        add item 2 of parts to policy_resources
        add item 3 of parts to policy_actions
    let request_input be ask for a number ""
    let request_count be value of request_input
    let allowed be 0
    let denied be 0
    repeat request_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let user be item 1 of parts
        let role be item 2 of parts
        let resource be item 3 of parts
        let action be item 4 of parts
        let matched be no
        let policy_index be 1
        repeat count times:
            let policy_role be item policy_index of policy_roles
            let policy_resource be item policy_index of policy_resources
            let policy_action be item policy_index of policy_actions
            if (policy_role is "*" or policy_role is role) and (policy_resource is "*" or policy_resource is resource) and (policy_action is "*" or policy_action is action):
                set matched to yes
            set policy_index to policy_index + 1
        if matched:
            say user + ":allow"
            set allowed to allowed + 1
        otherwise:
            say user + ":deny"
            set denied to denied + 1
    say "allowed=" + allowed + ",denied=" + denied

source_texts.notes_index_extension:
to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let notes be an empty list of text
    let nonempty be 0
    let characters be 0
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let note be ask ""
        add note to notes
        if length of note is more than 0:
            set nonempty to nonempty + 1
        set characters to characters + (length of note)
    write title + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    write "" to file "file_backed_notes_index.txt"
    let note_index be 1
    repeat count times:
        let saved_note be item note_index of notes
        append saved_note + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
        if length of saved_note is more than 0:
            append note_index + "|" + saved_note + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes_index.txt"
        set note_index to note_index + 1
    let saved be read file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    say title + "|" + count + "|" + nonempty + "|" + characters
source_texts.wildcard_policy_extension:
to main:
    let policies be an empty list of text
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        add line to policies
    let request_input be ask for a number ""
    let request_count be value of request_input
    let allowed be 0
    let denied be 0
    repeat request_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let user be item 1 of parts
        remove item 1 of parts
        let role be item 1 of parts
        let resource be item 2 of parts
        let action be item 3 of parts
        let matched be no
        for each policy in policies:
            let policy_parts be policy split by "|"
            let policy_role be item 1 of policy_parts
            let policy_resource be item 2 of policy_parts
            let policy_action be item 3 of policy_parts
            if (policy_role is "*" or policy_role is role) and (policy_resource is "*" or policy_resource is resource) and (policy_action is "*" or policy_action is action):
                set matched to yes
        if matched:
            say user + ":allow"
            set allowed to allowed + 1
        otherwise:
            say user + ":deny"
            set denied to denied + 1
    say "allowed=" + allowed + ",denied=" + denied
source_texts.invoice_net_extension:
to main:
    let customer be ask ""
    let item_input be ask for a number ""
    let item_count be value of item_input
    let totals be a map from text to number
    let subtotal be 0
    repeat item_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let category be item 1 of parts
        let quantity be item 2 of parts as number
        let price be item 3 of parts as number
        let amount be quantity * price
        set subtotal to subtotal + amount
        if totals contains category:
            set item category of totals to item category of totals + amount
        otherwise:
            set item category of totals to amount
    let output be an empty list of text
    let categories be keys of totals
    for each category in categories:
        add category + ":" + item category of totals to output
    let discount be 0
    if subtotal is at least 2000:
        set discount to floor of (subtotal / 10)
    let net be subtotal - discount
    say customer + "|" + subtotal + "|" + (output joined with ",") + "|discount=" + discount + "|net=" + net
source_texts.shipment_cancellation_extension:
to main:
    let shipment_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let shipment_count be value of shipment_count_input
    let states be a map from text to text
    repeat shipment_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        set item (item 1 of parts) of states to item 2 of parts
    let event_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let event_count be value of event_count_input
    let invalid be 0
    repeat event_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let shipment_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains shipment_id:
            let state be item shipment_id of states
            if state is "created" and action is "pack":
                set item shipment_id of states to "packed"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "ship":
                set item shipment_id of states to "shipped"
            otherwise if state is "shipped" and action is "deliver":
                set item shipment_id of states to "delivered"
            otherwise if (state is "created" or state is "packed") and action is "cancel":
                set item shipment_id of states to "cancelled"
            otherwise:
                set invalid to invalid + 1
        otherwise:
            set invalid to invalid + 1
    let results be an empty list of text
    let shipment_ids be keys of states
    for each shipment_id in shipment_ids:
        add shipment_id + ":" + item shipment_id of states to results
    say (results joined with ",") + "|invalid=" + (invalid as text)

source_texts.notes_index_extension:
to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let notes be an empty list of text
    let nonempty be 0
    let characters be 0
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let note be ask ""
        add note to notes
        if length of note is more than 0:
            set nonempty to nonempty + 1
        set characters to characters + (length of note)
    write title + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    let note_index be 1
    repeat count times:
        append (item note_index of notes) + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
        set note_index to note_index + 1
    let saved be read file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    write "" to file "file_backed_notes_index.txt"
    let saved_text be value of saved
    let saved_lines be saved_text split by "\n"
    let saved_index be 2
    let index_number be 1
    repeat count times:
        let saved_note be item saved_index of saved_lines
        if length of saved_note is more than 0:
            append index_number + "|" + saved_note + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes_index.txt"
        set saved_index to saved_index + 1
        set index_number to index_number + 1
    say title + "|" + count + "|" + nonempty + "|" + characters
source_texts.invoice_net_extension:
to main:
    let customer be ask ""
    let item_input be ask for a number ""
    let item_count be value of item_input
    let totals be a map from text to number
    let subtotal be 0
    repeat item_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let category be item 1 of parts
        let quantity be item 2 of parts as number
        let price be item 3 of parts as number
        let amount be quantity * price
        set subtotal to subtotal + amount
        if totals contains category:
            set item category of totals to item category of totals + amount
        otherwise:
            set item category of totals to amount
    let output be an empty list of text
    let categories be keys of totals
    for each category in categories:
        add category + ":" + item category of totals to output
    let discount be 0
    if subtotal is at least 2000:
        set discount to floor of (subtotal / 10)
    let net be subtotal - discount
    say customer + "|" + subtotal + "|" + (output joined with ",") + "|discount=" + discount + "|net=" + net
source_texts.shipment_cancellation_extension:
to main:
    let shipment_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let shipment_count be value of shipment_count_input
    let states be a map from text to text
    repeat shipment_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        set item (item 1 of parts) of states to item 2 of parts
    let event_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let event_count be value of event_count_input
    let invalid be 0
    repeat event_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let shipment_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains shipment_id:
            let state be item shipment_id of states
            if state is "created" and action is "pack":
                set item shipment_id of states to "packed"
            otherwise if state is "created" and action is "cancel":
                set item shipment_id of states to "cancelled"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "ship":
                set item shipment_id of states to "shipped"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "cancel":
                set item shipment_id of states to "cancelled"
            otherwise if state is "shipped" and action is "deliver":
                set item shipment_id of states to "delivered"
            otherwise:
                set invalid to invalid + 1
        otherwise:
            set invalid to invalid + 1
    let results be an empty list of text
    let shipment_ids be keys of states
    for each shipment_id in shipment_ids:
        add shipment_id + ":" + item shipment_id of states to results
    say (results joined with ",") + "|invalid=" + (invalid as text)
source_texts.wildcard_policy_extension:

    let request_count be value of request_input
    let allowed be 0
    let denied be 0
    repeat request_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let user be item 1 of parts
        let role be item 2 of parts
        let resource be item 3 of parts
        let action be item 4 of parts
        let matched be no
        for each policy in policies:
            let policy_parts be policy split by "|"
            let policy_role be item 1 of policy_parts
            let policy_resource be item 2 of policy_parts
            let policy_action be item 3 of policy_parts
            if (policy_role is "*" or policy_role is role) and (policy_resource is "*" or policy_resource is resource) and (policy_action is "*" or policy_action is action):
                set matched to yes
        if matched:
            say user + ":allow"
            set allowed to allowed + 1
        otherwise:
            say user + ":deny"
            set denied to denied + 1
    say "allowed=" + allowed + ",denied=" + denied

to main:
    let customer be ask ""
    let item_input be ask for a number ""
    let item_count be value of item_input
    let totals be a map from text to number
    let subtotal be 0
    repeat item_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let category be item 1 of parts
        let quantity be item 2 of parts as number
        let price be item 3 of parts as number
        let amount be quantity * price
        set subtotal to subtotal + amount
        if totals contains category:
            set item category of totals to item category of totals + amount
        otherwise:
            set item category of totals to amount
    let output be an empty list of text
    let categories be keys of totals
    for each category in categories:

    let discount be 0
    if subtotal is at least 2000:

    let net be subtotal - discount
    say customer + "|" + subtotal + "|" + (output joined with ",") + "|discount=" + discount + "|net=" + net
sources.notes_index_extension:
to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let notes be an empty list of text
    let nonempty be 0
    let characters be 0
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let note be ask ""
        add note to notes
        if length of note is more than 0:
            set nonempty to nonempty + 1
        set characters to characters + (length of note)
    write title + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    let note_index be 1
    repeat count times:
        append (item note_index of notes) + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
        set note_index to note_index + 1
    let saved be read file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    write "" to file "file_backed_notes_index.txt"
    let saved_text be value of saved
    let saved_lines be saved_text split by "\n"
    let saved_index be 2
    let index_number be 1
    repeat count times:
        let saved_note be item saved_index of saved_lines
        if length of saved_note is more than 0:
            append index_number + "|" + saved_note + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes_index.txt"
        set saved_index to saved_index + 1
        set index_number to index_number + 1
    say title + "|" + count + "|" + nonempty + "|" + characters

to main:
    let shipment_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let shipment_count be value of shipment_count_input
    let states be a map from text to text
    repeat shipment_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        set item (item 1 of parts) of states to item 2 of parts
    let event_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let event_count be value of event_count_input
    let invalid be 0
    repeat event_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let shipment_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains shipment_id:
            let state be item shipment_id of states
            if state is "created" and action is "pack":
                set item shipment_id of states to "packed"
            otherwise if state is "created" and action is "cancel":
                set item shipment_id of states to "cancelled"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "ship":
                set item shipment_id of states to "shipped"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "cancel":
                set item shipment_id of states to "cancelled"
            otherwise if state is "shipped" and action is "deliver":
                set item shipment_id of states to "delivered"
            otherwise:
                set invalid to invalid + 1
        otherwise:
            set invalid to invalid + 1
    let results be an empty list of text
    let shipment_ids be keys of states
    for each shipment_id in shipment_ids:
        add shipment_id + ":" + item shipment_id of states to results
    say (results joined with ",") + "|invalid=" + (invalid as text)

source_texts.shipment_cancellation_extension:
to main:
    let shipment_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let shipment_count be value of shipment_count_input
    let states be a map from text to text
    repeat shipment_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        set item (item 1 of parts) of states to item 2 of parts
    let event_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let event_count be value of event_count_input
    let invalid be 0
    repeat event_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let shipment_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains shipment_id:
            let state be item shipment_id of states
            if state is "created" and action is "pack":
                set item shipment_id of states to "packed"
            otherwise if state is "created" and action is "cancel":
                set item shipment_id of states to "cancelled"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "ship":
                set item shipment_id of states to "shipped"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "cancel":
                set item shipment_id of states to "cancelled"
            otherwise if state is "shipped" and action is "deliver":
                set item shipment_id of states to "delivered"
            otherwise:
                set invalid to invalid + 1
        otherwise:
            set invalid to invalid + 1
    let results be an empty list of text
    let shipment_ids be keys of states
    for each shipment_id in shipment_ids:
        add shipment_id + ":" + item shipment_id of states to results
    say (results joined with ",") + "|invalid=" + (invalid as text)

        set characters to characters + (length of note)

            append (note_index as text) + "|" + note + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes_index.txt"
        set note_index to note_index + 1
    let saved be read file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    say title + "|" + count + "|" + nonempty + "|" + characters
source_texts.invoice_net_extension:
to main:
    let customer be ask ""
    let item_input be ask for a number ""
    let item_count be value of item_input
    let totals be a map from text to number
    let subtotal be 0
    repeat item_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let category be item 1 of parts
        let quantity be item 2 of parts as number
        let price be item 3 of parts as number
        let amount be quantity * price
        set subtotal to subtotal + amount
        if totals contains category:
            set item category of totals to item category of totals + amount
        otherwise:
            set item category of totals to amount
    let output be an empty list of text
    let categories be keys of totals
    for each category in categories:
        add category + ":" + item category of totals to output
    let discount be 0
    if subtotal is at least 2000:
        set discount to floor of (subtotal divided by 10)
    let net be subtotal - discount
    say customer + "|" + subtotal + "|" + (output joined with ",") + "|discount=" + discount + "|net=" + net
source_texts.wildcard_policy_extension:
to main:
    let policies be an empty list of text
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        add line to policies
    let request_input be ask for a number ""
    let request_count be value of request_input
    let allowed be 0
    let denied be 0
    repeat request_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let user be item 1 of parts
        let role be item 2 of parts
        let resource be item 3 of parts
        let action be item 4 of parts
        let matched be no
        for each policy in policies:
            let policy_parts be policy split by "|"
            let policy_role be item 1 of policy_parts
            let policy_resource be item 2 of policy_parts
            let policy_action be item 3 of policy_parts
            if (policy_role is "*" or policy_role is role) and (policy_resource is "*" or policy_resource is resource) and (policy_action is "*" or policy_action is action):
                set matched to yes
        if matched:
            say user + ":allow"
            set allowed to allowed + 1
        otherwise:
            say user + ":deny"
            set denied to denied + 1
    say "allowed=" + allowed + ",denied=" + denied

source_texts.notes_index_extension:
title = input()
count = int(input())
notes = [input() for _ in range(count)]

with open("file_backed_notes.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as notes_file:
    notes_file.write(title + "\n")
    for note in notes:
        notes_file.write(note + "\n")

with open("file_backed_notes.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as notes_file:
    stored_lines = notes_file.read().splitlines()

stored_title = stored_lines[0]
stored_notes = stored_lines[1:]
with open(
    "file_backed_notes_index.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline=""
) as index_file:
    for index, note in enumerate(stored_notes, start=1):
        if note:
            index_file.write(f"{index}|{note}\n")

nonempty = sum(bool(note) for note in stored_notes)
characters = sum(len(note) for note in stored_notes)
print(f"{stored_title}|{count}|{nonempty}|{characters}")
source_texts.invoice_net_extension:
customer = input()
item_count = int(input())
category_totals = {}
subtotal = 0

for _ in range(item_count):
    category, quantity_text, price_text = input().split("|", 2)
    amount = int(quantity_text) * int(price_text)
    subtotal += amount
    category_totals[category] = category_totals.get(category, 0) + amount

categories = ",".join(
    f"{category}:{category_totals[category]}" for category in sorted(category_totals)
)
discount = subtotal // 10 if subtotal >= 2000 else 0
net = subtotal - discount
print(f"{customer}|{subtotal}|{categories}|discount={discount}|net={net}")
source_texts.wildcard_policy_extension:
policy_count = int(input())
policies = set()
for _ in range(policy_count):
    role, resource, action = input().split("|", 2)
    policies.add((role, resource, action))

request_count = int(input())
allowed = 0
denied = 0
for _ in range(request_count):
    user, role, resource, action = input().split("|", 3)
    if any(
        (policy_role == "*" or policy_role == role)
        and (policy_resource == "*" or policy_resource == resource)
        and (policy_action == "*" or policy_action == action)
        for policy_role, policy_resource, policy_action in policies
    ):
        allowed += 1
        print(f"{user}:allow")
    else:
        denied += 1
        print(f"{user}:deny")

print(f"allowed={allowed},denied={denied}")

source_texts.wildcard_policy_extension:
to main:
    let policies be an empty list of text
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        add line to policies
    let request_input be ask for a number ""
    let request_count be value of request_input
    let allowed be 0
    let denied be 0
    repeat request_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let user be item 1 of parts
        let role be item 2 of parts
        let resource be item 3 of parts
        let action be item 4 of parts
        let matched be no
        for each policy in policies:
            let policy_parts be policy split by "|"
            let policy_role be item 1 of policy_parts
            let policy_resource be item 2 of policy_parts
            let policy_action be item 3 of policy_parts
            if (policy_role is "*" or policy_role is role) and (policy_resource is "*" or policy_resource is resource) and (policy_action is "*" or policy_action is action):
                set matched to yes
        if matched:
            say user + ":allow"
            set allowed to allowed + 1
        otherwise:
            say user + ":deny"
            set denied to denied + 1
    say "allowed=" + allowed + ",denied=" + denied
source_texts.invoice_net_extension:
to main:
    let customer be ask ""
    let item_input be ask for a number ""
    let item_count be value of item_input
    let totals be a map from text to number
    let subtotal be 0
    repeat item_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let category be item 1 of parts
        let quantity be item 2 of parts as number
        let price be item 3 of parts as number
        let amount be quantity * price
        set subtotal to subtotal + amount
        if totals contains category:
            set item category of totals to item category of totals + amount
        otherwise:
            set item category of totals to amount
    let output be an empty list of text
    let categories be keys of totals
    for each category in categories:
        add category + ":" + item category of totals to output
    let discount be 0
    if subtotal is at least 2000:
        set discount to floor of (subtotal / 10)
    let net be subtotal - discount
    say customer + "|" + subtotal + "|" + (output joined with ",") + "|discount=" + discount + "|net=" + net
source_texts.notes_index_extension:
to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let notes be an empty list of text
    let nonempty be 0
    let characters be 0
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let note be ask ""
        add note to notes
        if length of note is more than 0:
            set nonempty to nonempty + 1
        set characters to characters + (length of note)
    write title + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    write "" to file "file_backed_notes_index.txt"
    let note_index be 1
    repeat count times:
        let note be item note_index of notes
        append note + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
        if length of note is more than 0:
            append note_index + "|" + note + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes_index.txt"
        set note_index to note_index + 1
    let saved be read file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    say title + "|" + count + "|" + nonempty + "|" + characters
source_texts.shipment_cancellation_extension:
to main:
    let shipment_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let shipment_count be value of shipment_count_input
    let states be a map from text to text
    repeat shipment_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        set item (item 1 of parts) of states to item 2 of parts
    let event_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let event_count be value of event_count_input
    let invalid be 0
    repeat event_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let shipment_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains shipment_id:
            let state be item shipment_id of states
            if state is "created" and action is "pack":
                set item shipment_id of states to "packed"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "ship":
                set item shipment_id of states to "shipped"
            otherwise if state is "shipped" and action is "deliver":
                set item shipment_id of states to "delivered"
            otherwise if (state is "created" or state is "packed") and action is "cancel":
                set item shipment_id of states to "cancelled"
            otherwise:
                set invalid to invalid + 1
        otherwise:
            set invalid to invalid + 1
    let results be an empty list of text
    let shipment_ids be keys of states
    for each shipment_id in shipment_ids:
        add shipment_id + ":" + item shipment_id of states to results
    say (results joined with ",") + "|invalid=" + (invalid as text)

source_texts.notes_index_extension:
to main:
    let title be ask ""
    let notes be an empty list of text
    let nonempty be 0
    let characters be 0
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let note be ask ""
        add note to notes
        if length of note is more than 0:
            set nonempty to nonempty + 1
        set characters to characters + (length of note)
    write title + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    write "" to file "file_backed_notes_index.txt"
    let note_index be 1
    repeat count times:
        let note be item note_index of notes
        append note + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes.txt"
        if length of note is more than 0:
            append (note_index as text) + "|" + note + "\n" to file "file_backed_notes_index.txt"
        set note_index to note_index + 1
    let saved be read file "file_backed_notes.txt"
    say title + "|" + count + "|" + nonempty + "|" + characters
source_texts.shipment_cancellation_extension:
to main:
    let shipment_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let shipment_count be value of shipment_count_input
    let states be a map from text to text
    repeat shipment_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        set item (item 1 of parts) of states to item 2 of parts
    let event_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let event_count be value of event_count_input
    let invalid be 0
    repeat event_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let shipment_id be item 1 of parts
        let action be item 2 of parts
        if states contains shipment_id:
            let state be item shipment_id of states
            if state is "created" and action is "pack":
                set item shipment_id of states to "packed"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "ship":
                set item shipment_id of states to "shipped"
            otherwise if state is "shipped" and action is "deliver":
                set item shipment_id of states to "delivered"
            otherwise if state is "created" and action is "cancel":
                set item shipment_id of states to "cancelled"
            otherwise if state is "packed" and action is "cancel":
                set item shipment_id of states to "cancelled"
            otherwise:
                set invalid to invalid + 1
        otherwise:
            set invalid to invalid + 1
    let results be an empty list of text
    let shipment_ids be keys of states
    for each shipment_id in shipment_ids:
        add shipment_id + ":" + item shipment_id of states to results
    say (results joined with ",") + "|invalid=" + (invalid as text)
source_texts.invoice_net_extension:
to main:
    let customer be ask ""
    let item_input be ask for a number ""
    let item_count be value of item_input
    let totals be a map from text to number
    let subtotal be 0
    repeat item_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let category be item 1 of parts
        let quantity be item 2 of parts as number
        let price be item 3 of parts as number
        let amount be quantity * price
        set subtotal to subtotal + amount
        if totals contains category:
            set item category of totals to item category of totals + amount
        otherwise:
            set item category of totals to amount
    let output be an empty list of text
    let categories be keys of totals
    for each category in categories:
        add category + ":" + item category of totals to output
    let discount be 0
    if subtotal is at least 2000:
        set discount to floor of (subtotal divided by 10)
    let net be subtotal - discount
    say customer + "|" + subtotal + "|" + (output joined with ",") + "|discount=" + discount + "|net=" + net
source_texts.wildcard_policy_extension:
to main:
    let policies be an empty list of text
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        add line to policies
    let request_input be ask for a number ""
    let request_count be value of request_input
    let allowed be 0
    let denied be 0
    repeat request_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let user be item 1 of parts
        let request_role be item 2 of parts
        let request_resource be item 3 of parts
        let request_action be item 4 of parts
        let matched be no
        for each policy in policies:
            let policy_parts be policy split by "|"
            let policy_role be item 1 of policy_parts
            let policy_resource be item 2 of policy_parts
            let policy_action be item 3 of policy_parts
            if (policy_role is "*" or policy_role is request_role) and (policy_resource is "*" or policy_resource is request_resource) and (policy_action is "*" or policy_action is request_action):
                set matched to yes
        if matched:
            say user + ":allow"
            set allowed to allowed + 1

invoice_net_extension.task_title: Add invoice discount and net total
invoice_net_extension.source_text:
to main:
    let customer be ask ""
    let item_input be ask for a number ""
    let item_count be value of item_input
    let totals be a map from text to number
    let subtotal be 0
    repeat item_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by "|"
        let category be item 1 of parts
        let quantity be item 2 of parts as number
        let price be item 3 of parts as number
        let amount be quantity * price
        set subtotal to subtotal + amount
        if totals contains category:
            set item category of totals to item category of totals + amount
        otherwise:
            set item category of totals to amount
    let output be an empty list of text
    let categories be keys of totals
    for each category in categories:
        add category + ":" + item category of totals to output
    let discount be 0
    if subtotal is at least 2000:
        set discount to floor of (subtotal divided by 10)
    let net be subtotal - discount
    say customer + "|" + subtotal + "|" + (output joined with ",") + "|discount=" + discount + "|net=" + net

source_texts.notes_index_extension:
title = input()
count = int(input())
notes = [input() for _ in range(count)]

with open("file_backed_notes.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as notes_file:
    notes_file.write(title + "\n")
    for note in notes:
        notes_file.write(note + "\n")

with open("file_backed_notes_index.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as index_file:
    for index, note in enumerate(notes, start=1):
        if note:
            index_file.write(f"{index}|{note}\n")

with open("file_backed_notes.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as notes_file:
    stored_lines = notes_file.read().splitlines()

stored_title = stored_lines[0]
stored_notes = stored_lines[1:]
nonempty = sum(bool(note) for note in stored_notes)
characters = sum(len(note) for note in stored_notes)
print(f"{stored_title}|{count}|{nonempty}|{characters}")
source_texts.invoice_net_extension:
customer = input()
item_count = int(input())
category_totals = {}
subtotal = 0

for _ in range(item_count):
    category, quantity_text, price_text = input().split("|", 2)
    amount = int(quantity_text) * int(price_text)
    subtotal += amount
    category_totals[category] = category_totals.get(category, 0) + amount

categories = ",".join(
    f"{category}:{category_totals[category]}" for category in sorted(category_totals)
)
discount = subtotal // 10 if subtotal >= 2000 else 0
net = subtotal - discount
print(f"{customer}|{subtotal}|{categories}|discount={discount}|net={net}")
source_texts.wildcard_policy_extension:
policy_count = int(input())
policies = set()
for _ in range(policy_count):
    role, resource, action = input().split("|", 2)
    policies.add((role, resource, action))

request_count = int(input())
allowed = 0
denied = 0
for _ in range(request_count):
    user, role, resource, action = input().split("|", 3)
    matches = any(
        (policy_role == "*" or policy_role == role)
        and (policy_resource == "*" or policy_resource == resource)
        and (policy_action == "*" or policy_action == action)
        for policy_role, policy_resource, policy_action in policies
    )
    if matches:
        allowed += 1
        print(f"{user}:allow")
    else:
        denied += 1
        print(f"{user}:deny")

print(f"allowed={allowed},denied={denied}")
